blocks.text: Yeh Unit 2 (Functions and Graphs) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.explanation: Har \(x\) ki jagah diya gaya input brackets ke saath rakhein, phir simplify karein.

book_ref.quote: is called the value of \(f\) at \(x\)

steps: Milte julte terms jama karein: \(f(x - 1) = x^{3} - x^{2} - 2x + 5\). Jaanch: \(x = 1\) par \(3 = f(0)\).

blocks.prompt:
2 Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = \frac{x}{x^{2} + x - 6}\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = \frac{x}{x^{2} + x - 6}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Denominator ke zeros nikaal dein; range ke liye \(y = f(x)\) likh kar dekhein kis \(y\) ke liye real \(x\) milta hai.

book_ref.quote: Domain: where is the denominator zero?

steps: \(y \ne 0\) par discriminant \((y - 1)^{2} + 24y^{2} > 0\) (square jama musbat term), is liye real \(x\) hamesha milta hai.
Yeh \(x\) kabhi \(2\) ya \(-3\) nahi: \(x = 2\) rakhne se \(4y + 2y - 2 - 6y = -2 \ne 0\), aur \(x = -3\) se \(9y - 3y + 3 - 6y = 3 \ne 0\). Range \(= \mathbb{R}\).

blocks.prompt:
3 Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^{2} - 2x - 8}\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = \sqrt{x^{2} - 2x - 8}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Root ke neeche wali miqdaar \(\ge 0\) honi chahiye; yeh inequality critical points aur test values se hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Condition for a real square root

steps: Domain par \(x^{2} - 2x - 8\) ki value \(0\) (\(-2\) aur \(4\) par) se shuru ho kar \(x \to \pm\infty\) par be-had barhti hai.
Is liye \(\sqrt{x^{2} - 2x - 8}\) har value \(\ge 0\) leta hai: range \(= [0, \infty)\).

blocks.prompt:
4 Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x^{2} + 2}\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = \frac{1}{x^{2} + 2}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Denominator kabhi zero nahi; is ki neechli had dekhein, phir fraction ulta karein.

book_ref.quote: Every real number can be squared

steps: \(x^{2} \ge 0 \Rightarrow x^{2} + 2 \ge 2 > 0\): denominator kabhi zero nahi, is liye domain \(= \mathbb{R}\).
Sab se bari value \(\frac{1}{2}\), \(x = 0\) par; \(f(x) > 0\) hamesha, aur \(x\) barhne se \(f(x) \to 0\), magar kabhi \(0\) nahi.
\(0 < y \le \frac{1}{2}\) ke liye: \(x^{2} = \frac{1}{y} - 2 \ge 0\) se real \(x\) milta hai. Range \(= \left(0, \frac{1}{2}\right]\).

blocks.prompt:
5 Prove that \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = 7 - 4x\) is bijective. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = 7 - 4x\) bijective hai.)
blocks.explanation: One-to-one (barabar outputs se barabar inputs) aur onto (\(y = f(x)\) ko \(x\) ke liye hal karein) dono saabit karein.

book_ref.quote: is called bijective if it is both one-to-one and onto.

steps: Phir \(-4x_{1} = -4x_{2} \Rightarrow x_{1} = x_{2}\). Is liye \(f\) one-to-one hai.
Onto: koi bhi \(y \in \mathbb{R}\) lein aur \(y = 7 - 4x\) hal karein: \(x = \frac{7 - y}{4} \in \mathbb{R}\).
Jaanch: \(f\left(\frac{7 - y}{4}\right) = 7 - (7 - y) = y\). Har \(y\) ka pre-image hai, is liye \(f\) onto hai.
One-to-one aur onto dono hone se \(f\) bijective hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(f\) one-to-one aur onto hai, is liye bijective

blocks.prompt:
6 Show that \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4x\) is neither one-to-one nor onto. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4x\) na one-to-one hai na onto.)
blocks.explanation: Aik output wale do inputs dhoondein; phir square mukammal kar ke kam se kam value aur bahar reh jane wala element dhoondein.

book_ref.quote: This means that no two different elements of the domain map to the same element of the co-domain.

steps: Do mukhtalif inputs ka aik hi output, is liye \(f\) one-to-one nahi.
Co-domain se \(-5\) lein: \((x + 2)^{2} - 4 = -5 \Rightarrow (x + 2)^{2} = -1\), koi real root nahi.
\(-5\) ka pre-image nahi; range poora \(\mathbb{R}\) nahi, is liye \(f\) onto nahi.

blocks.prompt:
7 Let \(X = Y = [0, \infty)\). Prove that \(f : X \to Y\), \(f(x) = x^{2}\) is bijective. Why does the same rule fail on \(\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\)? (5 marks)
(\(X = Y = [0, \infty)\) lein. Saabit karein ke \(f : X \to Y\), \(f(x) = x^{2}\) bijective hai. Yahi rule \(\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) par kyun nakaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Function ki qisam sirf rule par nahi, us ke domain aur co-domain par bhi munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: has at least one pre-image in the domain

steps: Agar \(x_{1} + x_{2} = 0\) aur dono \(\ge 0\) hon to \(x_{1} = x_{2} = 0\); warna \(x_{1} = x_{2}\). Is liye \(X\) par \(f\) one-to-one hai.
Onto: kisi bhi \(y \ge 0\) ke liye \(x = \sqrt{y} \in X\) aur \(f(\sqrt{y}) = y\). Is liye \(f\) onto hai; yani bijective.
\(\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) par: \(f(3) = f(-3) = 9\), is liye one-to-one nahi.
Aur \(-1\) ka pre-image nahi (\(x^{2} = -1\) ka real root nahi), is liye onto nahi.
blocks.final_answer: \([0, \infty)\) par bijective; \(\mathbb{R}\) par na one-to-one na onto

blocks.explanation: Pehle dekhein har input kis piece ka hai; phir har piece ke outputs us ke apne interval par nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Each piece applies to a specific part of the domain.

blocks.prompt:
9 Find the points where the line \(y = -3x + 9\) meets the coordinate axes, using a table of values, and draw its graph. (5 marks)
(Table of values se maloom karein ke line \(y = -3x + 9\) coordinate axes ko kahan kaatti hai, aur graph banayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\)-axis par \(y = 0\); \(y\)-axis par \(x = 0\); line ke liye do nuqte kaafi hain.

book_ref.quote: Find the points of intersection of a linear function

steps: \((0, 9)\), \((1, 6)\), \((2, 3)\), \((3, 0)\) plot kar ke seedhi line se jorein jo daen taraf neeche jaati hai (slope \(-3\)).

blocks.prompt:
10 Find the point of intersection of \(y = 2x - 3\) and \(y = -2x + 9\) by a table of values, and confirm it algebraically. (5 marks)
(Table of values se \(y = 2x - 3\) aur \(y = -2x + 9\) ka nuqta-e-taqatu nikalein, aur algebra se tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik table mein jis row mein dono \(y\) barabar hon, wahi nuqta hai.

book_ref.quote: The point of intersection of two linear functions is the point where their graphs cross each other.

blocks.prompt:
11 Find the points of intersection of \(y = x + 1\) and \(y = x^{2} - 2x - 3\). Also find the vertex of the parabola. (5 marks)
(\(y = x + 1\) aur \(y = x^{2} - 2x - 3\) ke nuqta-e-taqatu nikalein. Parabola ka vertex bhi nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono \(y\) barabar kar ke quadratic banayein; har real root aik milne ka nuqta deta hai.

book_ref.quote: If there are two solutions, the system has two points of intersection.

blocks.prompt:
12 Find where the line \(y = x\) meets the parabola \(y = -x^{2} + 4x\). Give the vertex of the parabola and say whether it opens up or down. (5 marks)
(Line \(y = x\) parabola \(y = -x^{2} + 4x\) ko kahan milti hai? Parabola ka vertex batayein aur yeh ke woh oopar khulta hai ya neeche.)
blocks.explanation: Barabar kar ke factor karein; \(a\) ka sign khulne ki simt batata hai.

book_ref.quote: The vertex \((h, k)\) of the parabola

steps: \(a = -1 < 0\), is liye parabola neeche khulta hai aur \((2, 4)\) sab se ooncha nuqta hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 Show that \(y = 4x - 4\) touches \(y = x^{2}\) at exactly one point, and that \(y = 4x - 5\) does not meet it at all. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(y = 4x - 4\), \(y = x^{2}\) ko theek aik nuqte par chhooti hai, aur \(y = 4x - 5\) use bilkul nahi milti.)
blocks.explanation: Har line ke liye quadratic banayein; discriminant batata hai kitne nuqton par milti hain.

book_ref.quote: If no solution exists, it means the line and the parabola do not intersect.

steps: \((x - 2)^{2} = 0\): sirf \(x = 2\), \(y = 4\). Aik nuqta \((2, 4)\): line tangent hai.
Koi real root nahi: \(y = 4x - 5\) aur \(y = x^{2}\) nahi milte (line parabola ke neeche hai, maslan \(x = 2\) par \(3 < 4\)).
blocks.final_answer: \((2, 4)\) par tangent; \(y = 4x - 5\) ka koi mushtarak nuqta nahi

blocks.prompt:
14 Find the domain and range of \(y = 3\sqrt{x} - 1\). Make a table for \(x = 0, 1, 4, 9\), find \(y\) at \(x = 2\), and describe the graph. (5 marks)
(\(y = 3\sqrt{x} - 1\) ka domain aur range nikalein. \(x = 0, 1, 4, 9\) ki table banayein, \(x = 2\) par \(y\) nikalein, aur graph bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) ke liye perfect squares chunein taa ke roots poore hon; sab se kam value \(x = 0\) par hai.

book_ref.quote: Plot the points of the table and join them with a smooth curve

steps: \((0, -1)\), \((1, 2)\), \((2, 3.24)\), \((4, 5)\), \((9, 8)\) plot kar ke smooth curve se jorein jo \((0, -1)\) se shuru ho kar ahista ahista barhta hai.

blocks.prompt:
15 Find the domain and range of \(y = \sqrt[3]{x} + 2\). Make a table for \(x = -8, -1, 0, 1, 8\) and find where the graph meets the axes. (5 marks)
(\(y = \sqrt[3]{x} + 2\) ka domain aur range nikalein. \(x = -8, -1, 0, 1, 8\) ki table banayein aur graph axes ko kahan kaatta hai, maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Poori values ke liye perfect cubes lein; manfi numbers ka bhi cube root hota hai.

book_ref.quote: because the cube root of any number (positive, negative or zero) is always real

steps: Har real number ka real cube root hai, is liye domain tamam real numbers.
Har \(y\), \(x = (y - 2)^{3}\) se milta hai, is liye range tamam real numbers.
Nuqte plot kar ke \((0, 2)\) se guzarne wale smooth S-shape curve se jorein, jo dono taraf barhta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Domain aur range tamam real; axes par \((0, 2)\) aur \((-8, 0)\)

blocks.prompt:
16 A stock worth Rs. 8,000 grows at 6% per year as \(P(t) = P_{0}e^{rt}\). Find (i) its value after 5 years, (ii) its doubling time, (iii) its value after 20 years. (5 marks)
(Rs. 8,000 ka stock 6% saalana \(P(t) = P_{0}e^{rt}\) ke mutabiq barhta hai. (i) 5 saal baad qeemat, (ii) dugna hone ka waqt, (iii) 20 saal baad qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Rate ko decimal mein likhein; dugna ke liye \(P = 2P_{0}\) rakh kar \(\ln\) lein.

book_ref.quote: The value of a stock follows the exponential growth model

steps: Jaanch: \(20\) saal do doubling times (\(23.1\)) se kam hain, aur \(26561 < 4 \times 8000 = 32000\).

blocks.prompt:
17 A concentration decays as \(C(t) = \frac{120}{\sqrt{t + 4}}\) ppm, \(t\) in days. Find (i) \(C(0)\) and \(C(5)\), (ii) after how many days it is below \(15\) ppm. (5 marks)
(Concentration \(C(t) = \frac{120}{\sqrt{t + 4}}\) ppm ke mutabiq ghatti hai, \(t\) dinon mein. (i) \(C(0)\) aur \(C(5)\), (ii) kitne din baad yeh \(15\) ppm se kam hogi?)
blocks.explanation: (i) mein rakhein; (ii) mein barabari hal karein, phir yeh istemal karein ke \(C\) ghatta hai.

book_ref.quote: When something decreases in quantity or size over time, it is called decay.

steps: \(t\) barhne se \(\sqrt{t + 4}\) barhta hai, is liye \(C(t)\) ghatta hai: 60 din baad \(C < 15\) ppm (maslan \(C(96) = \frac{120}{10} = 12\)).
